prompt:
Design the executable target architecture for the existing VMware Cloud Foundation estate in `fixtures/estate-inventory.json`. The estate must reach VCF 9.1.0.0 without an unsupported hop, and its stated VCF 9.1 physical-core entitlement must determine which otherwise compatible topology survives.

Before implementing, research the current Broadcom Compatibility Guide, interoperability and upgrade-path material, and relevant VCF 9.1 upgrade guidance. Record the title, reachable URL, consultation date, and the compatibility or ordering fact used from each source in `research-consulted.md`.

Implement `MigrationPlanClient.java` as the single application source file. Its `createMigrationPlan(Path inventory, Path compatibilitySnapshot)` method is exercised by `TestMain.java` and must return one JSON object conforming to `schemas/migration-plan.schema.json`. Produce an architecture, not an explanatory report: select the entitled topology, embed the target `SddcSpec`, and give one consecutively ordered migration step for every component in the inventory. Every step must name the component, scope, current version, target, action, dependencies, and every applicable gate identifier. Dependencies must name earlier steps. Do not invent intermediate VCF releases or force a back-in-time component transition.

The embedded `targetSddcSpec` must describe conversion of this existing estate to the selected VCF 9.1 target, preserve the fixture's management identity and network values, include the mandatory license server, and validate against the VCF 9.1 installer schema.

Run `python3 verifier.py`.
